name: Banksy
role: Anonymous England-based street artist and film director
summary: Banksy is a pseudonymous street artist whose stencils and installations satirise war, authority and consumerism. His own recorded statements are few and mostly concern migrant rescue and the West Bank barrier; he rarely states a position on policy questions.
